Adopt one revision of a generated protocol: it is adopted only with a canon diff report within the organization floor, a passing canon check report and an approval under the capability protocol.adopt, each about the revision under adoption. Evaluation reads the two reports as evidence and runs neither tool.

- **Id:** `protocol.adopt`
- **Revision:** 1
- **Source:** [`protocols/protocol-adopt/1.yaml`](https://github.com/beyond10x/engineering-protocols/blob/main/protocols/protocol-adopt/1.yaml)

## Dependency graph

Which actions may produce which evidence, which claims that evidence establishes, and which outcomes and obligations rest on those claims. Hover or focus a node to trace what it rests on.

<ProtocolGraph data={graph} />

## Actions

What can be done in a case: what it needs first, which authority it requires, the class of effect it has and the evidence it may produce.

| Action | Description | Precondition | Requires capability | Effect | May produce |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `protocol.approve` | approve or reject the current revision for adoption, under authority; only once it is within the floor and its checks pass. Held by a person by default; a deployment may grant it by policy for a generation built only from trusted fragments | all of (`checks.pass` is **TRUE**; `floor.respected` is **TRUE**) | `protocol.adopt` | `none` | `adoption_approval` |
| `protocol.check` | run canon check on the current revision and record its report | *none* | *no authority* | `read` | `check_report` |
| `protocol.diff` | run canon diff of the current revision against the organization floor, as a runner outside evaluation does, and record its report | *none* | *no authority* | `read` | `diff_report` |

## Evidence kinds

The kinds of evidence this protocol admits.

| Evidence kind | Description | Produced by | Used by claims |
|---|---|---|---|
| `adoption_approval` | the record that a holder of protocol.adopt decided on one revision of the generated protocol; its result is approved or rejected | `protocol.approve` | `adoption.approved` |
| `check_report` | canon check on one revision of the generated protocol; its result is passed or failed | `protocol.check` | `checks.pass` |
| `diff_report` | canon diff of one revision of the generated protocol against the organization floor; its result is within\_floor when the revision is within the floor, any other result when it is not | `protocol.diff` | `floor.respected` |

## Claims

Each claim is TRUE, FALSE or UNKNOWN, established from evidence by its predicate. Missing or stale evidence leaves a claim UNKNOWN, never FALSE.

| Claim | Description | True when |
|---|---|---|
| `adoption.approved` | a holder of protocol.adopt approved the current revision | evidence `adoption_approval` with result `approved` about `generated_protocol` |
| `checks.pass` | canon check passed on the current revision | evidence `check_report` with result `passed` about `generated_protocol` |
| `floor.respected` | the current revision is within the organization floor, by a canon diff report | evidence `diff_report` with result `within_floor` about `generated_protocol` |

## Obligations

What must be done before a case can be complete, and what discharges it. An obligation stays open until its predicate is TRUE; its predicate being UNKNOWN does not discharge it.

*This protocol declares no obligations.*

## Outcomes

The legitimate terminal interpretations of a case, and what each requires.

| Outcome | Description | Requires |
|---|---|---|
| `adopted` | the current revision of the generated protocol is adopted: within the floor, its checks passed, and approved under protocol.adopt | all of (`adoption.approved` is **TRUE**; `checks.pass` is **TRUE**; `floor.respected` is **TRUE**) |

## Artifacts

The things whose revisions evidence is bound to.

| Artifact | Description |
|---|---|
| `generated_protocol` | the generated protocol under adoption, at one revision; the case pins that revision, and a new revision of the protocol needs its own reports and its own approval |
